transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just here because... well, it's about my house. The foreclosure. Everyone keeps acting like it's just paperwork and missed payments. But... I know it's not. 

The bank, the loan servicer... even people at my job. I know they’ve been quietly working together to push me out of my house. They keep showing me all these papers, but... no amount of papers changes what I’ve been seeing for almost two years now. So... yeah. That's why.

During these past two years, have you had any stretches of time where your mood was either very low, hopeless, and lacking energy, or unusually high, elated, or irritable, separate from your concerns about the house?
No... not really. I mean, I don't think so. My mood is fine. It's just... the situation with the house. That's all.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people don't seem to hear, or seen things that others don't see?
No... I don't hear voices. Or see things that aren't there. Nothing like that. It's just... what I already told you about the house.
Aside from the situation with your house, how have things been going for you at work and with friends or family—are you able to keep up with your usual responsibilities and relationships?

Things are... fine. I still get up and go to work. I supervise my team, handle the schedules, deal with customer issues... I take care of myself. I keep up with my responsibilities. 

It's really just... the problems only happen when the mail comes, or the bank calls. Or if certain paperwork at my job starts... tying into what's happening with the house. But other than that... I do what I need to do.
